description: Founded in 1990, Apollo Global Management, Inc. is a high-growth global alternative asset manager and a retirement services provider that conducts its business primarily in the U.S. through three reportable segments: Asset Management, Retirement Services and Principal Investing. Its Asset Management segment focuses on credit and equity investing strategies, earning fees for providing investment management services and expertise to its client base and earning capital solutions fees alongside its private equity franchise, and it reported total assets under management of $938.4 billion as of December 31, 2025.
